revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Review 20261124 (issue #30): createThread clears the new Win32 thread id's shared USER queue (existing reset_thread_message_queue export, the same call exit cleanup makes) synchronously when the slot is allocated, before the id is published. No callback, continuation, scheduler or guest-context lifetime change. Covered by test/test-post-thread-message-before-start.js. General callback ownership remains pending.

revisions.name: export:init_thread
revisions.reason: Review 20261124 (issue #30): init_thread no longer resets a worker's shared post queue (only tid 0's); the queue is cleared at CreateThread instead, so a message posted before an asynchronous Worker start survives (UT splash WM_QUIT). No callback, continuation or guest-context lifetime change. Covered by test/test-post-thread-message-before-start.js. General callback ownership remains pending.
